title: Shipwreck Casserole
description: This shipwreck casserole turns easy ingredients like ground beef, macaroni and cheese, and frozen vegetables into a quick and easy kid-friendly dinner.
ingredients: 1 (7.25 ounce) package macaroni and cheese mix
1 teaspoon seasoned salt (such as LAWRY'S®), or to taste

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Stir pasta and cheese mixture from macaroni and cheese package into beef. Stir in tomatoes, milk, peas, and corn; bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until noodles are tender, about 12 minutes.
Season with seasoned salt. Stir 1/2 of the Cheddar cheese into dish to melt. Top with remaining cheese.

video.description: While this may not be the prettiest dinner, the satisfying flavor is unbeatable! In this video, learn how to make a one pan recipe for shipwreck casserole that combines browned ground beef with pasta and cheese. Like a homemade spin on Hamburger Helper, this creamy casserole is loaded with fresh veggies and melted cheese that the whole family will enjoy.
